summary.text: The Little Masters ("Kleinmeister" in German), were a group of German printmakers who worked in the first half of the 16th century, primarily in engraving.  They specialized in very small finely detailed prints, some no larger than a postage stamp.
The most eminent of the Little Masters as virtuosi of delicate engraving are unquestionably the brothers Barthel and Hans Sebald Beham, and Georg Pencz.

source.author: Arthur M. Hind
source.title: A Short History of Engraving and Etching
